verdict.comment: Having thrived since the tongue-tie and cheekpieces went on, NED TANNER is taken to follow up last month's C&D win.

comments.crebilly: Well handicapped on last season's best form and the drop back in trip could help
comments.densworth: Tailed off/pulled up the last twice but looked good in November & drops back down in grade
comments.gelinobello: Has back-class and his sights are lowered, but he's been pulled up the last twice
comments.leaderinthepark: Only third at Kelso when bidding for hat-trick but this unexposed 7yo remains of interest
comments.nedtanner: 9yo who is back up in grade off a career-high mark but he's clearly thriving
comments.persiantime: Two chase wins last term & he's below his last winning mark, but has struggled this season
comments.prairiewolf: Disappointing the last twice but good third in this 12 months ago and not written off
comments.riskintheground: Could build on last month's encouraging fifth and top trainer has good record in this race
comments.suretouch: Has dropped back down to his last winning mark but he needs to raise his game
comments.vintagefizz: Good second in the Grand Sefton last November when last seen, and has won when fresh
comments.walkonquest: 4-4 over fences before Uttoxeter flop, but this C&D winner could still be well treated
comments.willcarver: Promising start to chasing career last May; struggled in the autumn but could bounce back

races.raceComment: nedtanner is marginally preferred with a score of 61.7%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form and more reliable profile over persiantime. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good To Soft) looks ideal with 6 wins from 20 starts in similar conditions. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Excellent course form of 6/23 at ayr. verdict.comment: Very competitive in deeper races this season, ASTA LA PASTA could be hard to beat here if the drop back in trip suits him.

comments.astalapasta: Spoiled chance by racing too freely last time but has generally done well over fences
comments.dancethief: C&D winner in February; rather laboured last time but new cheekpieces might perk him up
comments.fromtheclouds: 2-4 over hurdles; makes chase debut after layoff but has plenty of pointing experience
comments.pasodoble: Not bred for fences but was a creditable second on latest hurdling start in January
comments.torneo: Ran on well for clear win at Chepstow last month and is now 2-6 over fences; respected

races.raceComment: torneo is marginally preferred with a score of 63.7%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and more progressive and more reliable profile over dancethief. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good To Soft) looks ideal with 3 wins from 13 starts in similar conditions. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include optimal distance and improving, though step up in class and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: If Sir Les Patterson transfers his AW form to turf he'll be hard to beat but it's a big enough 'if' to side with CHANGE SINGS.

comments.changesings: Progressive sprinter who made a pleasing return on AW last month; can rate higher still
comments.chiefmankato: Placed in four of his last five starts (all AW); likely vulnerable for win purposes here
comments.drama: Won two 6f handicaps on AW last year; career best needed to take this on his return
comments.havanapusey: Just missed out at Doncaster on return 12 days ago; 2lb well in and 2-2 second time out
comments.havanagreattime: Showed bright speed when 3rd at Southwell on return to 6f last month; chance with a repeat
comments.orne: Group 3 winner at 2; struggled on last three starts; down in class but not a solid option
comments.photosynthesis: Two 6f AW wins in early 2024 for T Clover; absent 406 days and gelded; feasible mark still
comments.rohaan: Not the force of old but handicapped accordingly & he's run some good races on AW in 2025
comments.rousingencore: Did well for Ruth Carr in the 2nd half of 2024; still feasibly weighted if ready to roll
comments.sirlespatterson: All form on AW thus far; looked good at Wolverhampton latest; just 1lb higher back on turf
comments.zouluchief: Useful nursery form at 2; absent since a quiet spell in Dubai in early 2024; check betting
